estimators: signed shared-context log ratio with variance shrinkage
budget: 2048 training tokens per strategy per arm per seed; three arms; shared 1536-token unwatermarked discovery cost per seed
sampling: full softmax, temperature 1, all tokenizer special tokens excluded, fixed length; fresh SynthID history per continuation
watermark: public evaluate.KEYS, context 4, existing HF SynthID configuration; replay skipped calls to populate generated-token context
evaluation: Exact watermark log probability ratio on top 32 baseline candidates; these oracle probabilities never enter fitting
primary: mean within-context Spearman on matched candidates
sign accuracy for oracle effects of absolute magnitude >= 0.2
splits: 32 queried anchors and 32 unqueried contexts scored separately; anchor evaluation measures local recovery, not novel-context generalization
controls: independent unwatermarked control versus baseline fit for each estimator and strategy
limitations: fixed model and public key across three sampling/prompt seeds
white-box collection/reset and oracle evaluation; estimator sees sampled token IDs only
candidate selection uses oracle baseline top32, so metrics are conditional on plausible candidates
no document-detection FPR or removal claim
normal-approximation uncertainty is a ranking heuristic, not calibrated confidence
